content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That range is where the research shows muscle-building benefits plateau. Spread it over 3–5 meals, with roughly 0.3–0.4 g/kg each, and make sure total calories are slightly above maintenance. 💪 Want me to work out a number for your bodyweight?
